original_target.title: Does entanglement-assisted capacity equal the Lovász bound?

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original regularizes alpha_star over all strong powers and arbitrary finite-dimensional shared states, asking Theta_star(G)=theta(G). Li–Zuiddam Conjecture19 states exactly this; its contradiction concerns two conjectures jointly and does not decide which one fails. Located one-shot, maximally-entangled/projective and quantum-channel separations have stricter or different models. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
